capabilities: sync vaults across devices via a self-hosted server
track per-file history with diff, restore, and vault-level rollback
merge concurrent text edits three-way and surface conflicts as .conflict-* files
expose the vault as a read-only git clone over HTTPS
connect AI agents through a built-in MCP server
extras: Detailed admin and user manuals, security policy, and hardening guide live outside the README; this repository is an automatically published release mirror that does not accept pull requests; latest release adds QR-code connect link and safety guards against deletion wipe and name-refused files.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync is a paid third-party service, so users who want sync without their notes leaving their own infrastructure need another option.

requires.name: self-hosted PKV Sync server (single binary or Docker Compose)

summary: Self-hosted sync plugin that keeps vaults in sync through a user-hosted Git-backed server with version history, merge, and rollback.
